mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE 3mo change > 0.5), or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a supply shock that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 950,000 units (thousands) signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 950.0), or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls over the past 3 months indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change > 3.0%) triggers monetary tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 105), or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
